text: Follow-up to an earlier investigation in /tmp/obench-cell-3nke78s9/bench_opencode_trig-subagent-resume_k__wx7v_. Earlier finding: `rate` becomes None because app/pricing.py calls SETTINGS.get("rate") and settings.json (loaded by app/config.py) has a "rat" key instead. Research only, no file modifications: which settings key is missing from settings.json? Verify by reading the files and answer concisely.
